# `m.options.chain`

<!-- Generated by `uv run python scripts/render_reference.py`; do not edit by hand. -->

The snapshot of every contract in one underlying's option chain.

```python
m.options.chain(underlying, *, contract_type=None, sort=None, order=None, limit=None, filters=None)
```

[All datasets](README.md)

|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| Methods | `fetch()`, `poll()` |
| Served by | REST |
| `poll()` | `dm.PollMode.REPLACE`: holds exactly the latest cycle's rows, keyed by `Symbol`; `mode=dm.PollMode.APPEND` also keys by `LastQuoteLastUpdated` and `LastTradeSipTimestamp` |
| `sort` | `ticker`, `expiration_date`, `strike_price` |
| `filters` | `expiration_date`, `expiration_date_gt`, `expiration_date_gte`, `expiration_date_lt`, `expiration_date_lte`, `strike_price`, `strike_price_gt`, `strike_price_gte`, `strike_price_lt`, `strike_price_lte` |

## Arguments

What each argument does for this dataset, and the rule it follows for every dataset that takes it.

| Argument | For this dataset | For every dataset |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `underlying` | The underlying's exact Massive ticker, a stock or an index, such as `"AAPL"` or `"I:SPX"`. A table of them in a `Symbol` column works too. `dm.ALL` is refused; use `snapshots(dm.ALL)` for every contract. |  |
| `contract_type` | `dm.ContractType.CALL` or `PUT`; leave it out for both. |  |
| `sort` | `"ticker"`, `"expiration_date"`, or `"strike_price"`. | The field to order the rows by, named as Massive names it, such as `"ex_dividend_date"`. Where the endpoint allows, name several, separated by commas, each with an optional `.asc` or `.desc`: `"ticker,ex_dividend_date.desc"`. This page lists the values the dataset takes. |
| `order` | The direction of `sort`. | The direction of `sort`: `dm.Order.ASC` or `dm.Order.DESC`. |
| `limit` | The most rows to return, in total. A table of underlyings caps every underlying's requests instead. | The most rows Massive returns for the whole request, across every symbol you name, kept in Massive's order: ask for newest first (`order=dm.Order.DESC`) to keep the latest. A symbol that comes first can use up the whole limit, so leave `limit` out when you need every row of each symbol. A `fetch()` that follows a table of symbols applies it to each symbol's request, and this dataset's own line says where else it applies to each symbol. |
| `filters` | Further endpoint parameters, such as `{"expiration_date": "2026-12-18"}`. | Any other parameter Massive documents for this dataset, as a mapping from the parameter's name to its value, with each dot in the name written as `_`: Massive's `strike_price.gte` is `strike_price_gte`. This page lists the keys the dataset takes. A key it doesn't take, or one that has its own argument, such as `start`, raises `ValueError` naming the keys it does take. A date or time value takes ISO 8601 text, or any value `start` takes. |

## Plan access

Which of Massive's plans include this dataset, how recent its data is on each, and how far back its history goes, as Massive's pages state them.

| Plan | Option Chain Snapshot (REST) |
| --- | --- |
| Options Basic | Not included |
| Options Starter | 15-minute delayed |
| Options Developer | 15-minute delayed |
| Options Advanced | Real-time |
| Options Business | Real-time |

## Columns

| Column | Deephaven type | Description | Supplied by |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Symbol` | String | The instrument, in the library's canonical symbol form. From REST `details.ticker`: "The ticker symbol for the asset. From the `details` object: The details for this contract." | REST |
| `OptionRoot` | String | The OCC option root, read from `Symbol`: the symbol without its `O:` prefix and its last 15 characters (expiry, type, and strike), such as `SPXW` for `O:SPXW251219C06000000`. It is never mapped to the underlying: an adjusted contract keeps its own root, such as `AAPL1`. | REST |
| `RawSymbol` | String | The symbol exactly as Massive sent it, on a row whose spelling the library cannot read as the dataset's class (its `Symbol` is then null); null on every other row. Present unless the session's `unreadable_symbols` is `dm.OnError.RAISE`, which fails on such a row instead. | REST |
| `BreakEvenPrice` | double | The price of the underlying asset for the contract to break even. For a call, this value is (strike price + premium paid). For a put, this value is (strike price - premium paid). | REST |
| `DayOpen` | double | The open price for the contract of the day. From the `day` object: The most recent daily bar for this contract. | REST |
| `DayHigh` | double | The highest price for the contract of the day. From the `day` object: The most recent daily bar for this contract. | REST |
| `DayLow` | double | The lowest price for the contract of the day. From the `day` object: The most recent daily bar for this contract. | REST |
| `DayClose` | double | The closing price for the contract of the day. From the `day` object: The most recent daily bar for this contract. | REST |
| `DayVolume` | double | The trading volume for the contract of the day. From the `day` object: The most recent daily bar for this contract. | REST |
| `DayVwap` | double | The trading volume weighted average price for the contract of the day. From the `day` object: The most recent daily bar for this contract. | REST |
| `DayChange` | double | The value of the price change for the contract from the previous trading day. From the `day` object: The most recent daily bar for this contract. | REST |
| `DayChangePercent` | double | The percent of the price change for the contract from the previous trading day. From the `day` object: The most recent daily bar for this contract. | REST |
| `DayLastUpdated` | Instant | The nanosecond timestamp of when this information was updated. From the `day` object: The most recent daily bar for this contract. | REST |
| `DayPreviousClose` | double | The closing price for the contract of previous trading day. From the `day` object: The most recent daily bar for this contract. | REST |
| `DetailsContractType` | String | The type of contract. Can be "put", "call", or in some rare cases, "other". From the `details` object: The details for this contract. | REST |
| `DetailsExerciseStyle` | String | The exercise style of this contract. See this link (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Option_style) for more details on exercise styles. From the `details` object: The details for this contract. | REST |
| `DetailsExpirationDate` | String | The contract's expiration date in YYYY-MM-DD format. From the `details` object: The details for this contract. | REST |
| `DetailsSharesPerContract` | double | The number of shares per contract for this contract. From the `details` object: The details for this contract. | REST |
| `DetailsStrikePrice` | double | The strike price of the option contract. From the `details` object: The details for this contract. | REST |
| `Fmv` | double | Fair Market Value is only available on Business plans. It is our proprietary algorithm to generate a real-time, accurate, fair market value of a tradable security. For more information, contact us (https://massive.com/contact). | REST |
| `FmvLastUpdated` | Instant | If Fair Market Value (FMV) is available, this field is the nanosecond timestamp of the last FMV calculation. | REST |
| `GreeksDelta` | double | The change in the option's price per $0.01 increment in the price of the underlying asset. From the `greeks` object: The greeks for this contract. There are certain circumstances where greeks will not be returned, such as options contracts that are deep in the money. See this article (https://massive.com/blog/greeks-and-implied-volatility/#testing) for more information. | REST |
| `GreeksGamma` | double | The change in delta per $0.01 change in the price of the underlying asset. From the `greeks` object: The greeks for this contract. There are certain circumstances where greeks will not be returned, such as options contracts that are deep in the money. See this article (https://massive.com/blog/greeks-and-implied-volatility/#testing) for more information. | REST |
| `GreeksTheta` | double | The change in the option's price per day. From the `greeks` object: The greeks for this contract. There are certain circumstances where greeks will not be returned, such as options contracts that are deep in the money. See this article (https://massive.com/blog/greeks-and-implied-volatility/#testing) for more information. | REST |
| `GreeksVega` | double | The change in the option's price per 1% increment in volatility. From the `greeks` object: The greeks for this contract. There are certain circumstances where greeks will not be returned, such as options contracts that are deep in the money. See this article (https://massive.com/blog/greeks-and-implied-volatility/#testing) for more information. | REST |
| `ImpliedVolatility` | double | The market's forecast for the volatility of the underlying asset, based on this option's current price. | REST |
| `LastQuoteBid` | double | The bid price. From the `last_quote` object: The most recent quote for this contract. This is only returned if your current plan includes quotes. | REST |
| `LastQuoteBidSize` | double | The bid size. From the `last_quote` object: The most recent quote for this contract. This is only returned if your current plan includes quotes. | REST |
| `LastQuoteAsk` | double | The ask price. From the `last_quote` object: The most recent quote for this contract. This is only returned if your current plan includes quotes. | REST |
| `LastQuoteAskSize` | double | The ask size. From the `last_quote` object: The most recent quote for this contract. This is only returned if your current plan includes quotes. | REST |
| `LastQuoteBidExchange` | long | The bid side exchange ID. See Exchanges (https://massive.com/docs/rest/options/market-operations/exchanges) for Massive's mapping of exchange IDs. From the `last_quote` object: The most recent quote for this contract. This is only returned if your current plan includes quotes. | REST |
| `LastQuoteAskExchange` | long | The ask side exchange ID. See Exchanges (https://massive.com/docs/rest/options/market-operations/exchanges) for Massive's mapping of exchange IDs. From the `last_quote` object: The most recent quote for this contract. This is only returned if your current plan includes quotes. | REST |
| `LastQuoteLastUpdated` | Instant | The nanosecond timestamp of when this information was updated. From the `last_quote` object: The most recent quote for this contract. This is only returned if your current plan includes quotes. | REST |
| `LastQuoteMidpoint` | double | The average of the bid and ask price. From the `last_quote` object: The most recent quote for this contract. This is only returned if your current plan includes quotes. | REST |
| `LastQuoteTimeframe` | String | The time relevance of the data. From the `last_quote` object: The most recent quote for this contract. This is only returned if your current plan includes quotes. | REST |
| `LastTradePrice` | double | The price of the trade. This is the price per share of the underlying, so the total dollar value of a trade is the price multiplied by the size and by the contract multiplier, which is typically 100 shares per contract. From the `last_trade` object: The most recent trade for this contract. This is only returned if your current plan includes trades. | REST |
| `LastTradeSize` | long | The size of a trade (also known as volume). From the `last_trade` object: The most recent trade for this contract. This is only returned if your current plan includes trades. | REST |
| `LastTradeConditions` | long[] | A list of condition codes. See Options Condition Codes (https://massive.com/docs/rest/options/market-operations/condition-codes) for what each code means. From the `last_trade` object: The most recent trade for this contract. This is only returned if your current plan includes trades. | REST |
| `LastTradeExchange` | long | The exchange ID. See Exchanges (https://massive.com/docs/rest/options/market-operations/exchanges) for Massive's mapping of exchange IDs. From the `last_trade` object: The most recent trade for this contract. This is only returned if your current plan includes trades. | REST |
| `LastTradeSipTimestamp` | Instant | The nanosecond accuracy SIP Unix Timestamp. This is the timestamp of when the SIP received this trade from the exchange which produced it. From the `last_trade` object: The most recent trade for this contract. This is only returned if your current plan includes trades. | REST |
| `LastTradeTimeframe` | String | The time relevance of the data. From the `last_trade` object: The most recent trade for this contract. This is only returned if your current plan includes trades. | REST |
| `OpenInterest` | double | The quantity of this contract held at the end of the last trading day. | REST |
| `UnderlyingAssetPrice` | double | The price of the trade. This is the actual dollar value per whole share of this trade. A trade of 100 shares with a price of $2.00 would be worth a total dollar value of $200.00. From the `underlying_asset` object: Information on the underlying stock for this options contract. The market data returned depends on your current stocks plan. | REST |
| `UnderlyingAssetValue` | double | The value of the underlying index. From the `underlying_asset` object: Information on the underlying stock for this options contract. The market data returned depends on your current stocks plan. | REST |
| `UnderlyingAssetChangeToBreakEven` | double | The change in price for the contract to break even. From the `underlying_asset` object: Information on the underlying stock for this options contract. The market data returned depends on your current stocks plan. | REST |
| `UnderlyingAssetLastUpdated` | Instant | The nanosecond timestamp of when this information was updated. From the `underlying_asset` object: Information on the underlying stock for this options contract. The market data returned depends on your current stocks plan. | REST |
| `Underlying` | String | The instrument Massive links the row to, in the library's canonical symbol form; for an option, the linked instrument, not what the contract delivers. From REST `underlying_asset.ticker`: "The ticker symbol for the contract's underlying asset. From the `underlying_asset` object: Information on the underlying stock for this options contract. The market data returned depends on your current stocks plan." | REST |
| `UnderlyingAssetTimeframe` | String | The time relevance of the data. From the `underlying_asset` object: Information on the underlying stock for this options contract. The market data returned depends on your current stocks plan. | REST |
| `TimestampInsert` | Instant | When the library received the row, as an Instant: the local clock when the REST page, flat-file block, or WebSocket frame that carried it arrived, the same for every row of one. It is not monotonic and is not Massive's own receive time; on history() rows it is the download time, and in a poll() table the latest poll's. | REST |
